argv:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
unset VITE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL GINFER_MODEL_CATALOG_URL IS_DEV NODE_OPTIONS NODE_ENV FORCE_ONBOARDING FRESH_INSTALL FORCE_HARDWARE_TIER TAURI_CONFIG TAURI_DEV_HOST TAURI_ENV_DEBUG IS_IOS IS_ANDROID IS_CLEAN CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS CARGO_BUILD_TARGET RUSTFLAGS GINFER_PROFILE_CATALOGS
trap 'code=$?; printf "%s\n" "$code" > /work/chain.exit; date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/chain.finished' EXIT
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/chain.started
printf "%s\n" focused_frontend > /work/current-stage
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/focused_frontend.started
if yarn workspace @gchat/web-app vitest run src/routes/hub/__tests__/index.test.tsx > /work/focused_frontend.log 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$code" > /work/focused_frontend.exit
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/focused_frontend.finished
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$code"; fi
printf "%s\n" focused_native > /work/current-stage
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/focused_native.started
if cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/plugins/tauri-plugin-ginfer/Cargo.toml managed::tests::desktop_attaches_and_reuses_auto_kv_profiles_and_preserves_explicit_budgets -- --test-threads=1 > /work/focused_native.log 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$code" > /work/focused_native.exit
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/focused_native.finished
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$code"; fi
printf "%s\n" verify > /work/current-stage
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/verify.started
if make verify > /work/verify.log 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$code" > /work/verify.exit
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/verify.finished
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$code"; fi
printf "complete\n" > /work/current-stage
